memory_policy: Only proven GPU limits skipped before allocation; estimates recorded only. Stop current process on RSS >18 GiB, available RAM <512 MiB sustained 10s, or disk <1 GiB. No wall-clock kill. Each seed independent.
warmup: seed999 once per graph/p/session, except explicit capacity-only resume may reuse a validated successful same-binary/same-parameters warmup <=30 minutes old; reuse source is logged; excluded from formal results
execution_context: User requested Codex execution instead of previously planned manual terminal run. Codex remains resident; environment is not a minimal OS-only state.
initial_positions: Native algorithm retained: same seed across p does not guarantee identical initial coordinates because preprocessing consumes RNG. Fingerprints retained; pivot lists not forced to align.
archive_format: xz preset0 CRC64; decompressed SHA256 and length validated before removing original; archival excluded from native timing. Initial recovery pilot used preset3 (manifest retains it).
pre_run_disk_formula: 4 GiB + 160n + 48m bytes; includes two complete native edge lists
capacity_defer_policy: If a graph cannot meet pre/post-warmup reserve, keep its remaining jobs pending (not failures) and preserve its pivot/seed order. Execute other approved graphs that fit. Actual deferrals logged in validation/schedule-deferred-*.json.

storage_sharing.scope: Large successful com-Orkut only; normal6030 unchanged
storage_sharing.format: Self-contained gzip with three concatenated members; first member FEXTRA padded to 64KiB; edge member shared with APFS clonefile
storage_sharing.verification: Full original-text SHA256/length and gzip EOF CRC; template digest immutable after writes; native measurement fields unchanged
storage_sharing.future_runs: Native layout/Stress unchanged; XZ archival then verified shared gzip repack after all measurement; store both archival durations
